google_play.title: Onceover: Photo Cleanup
google_play.short_description: Swipe to keep or toss photos. Undo for 30 days. No ads. Pay once.
google_play.full_description:
Thousands of photos and no energy to sort them? Onceover turns your camera roll into one quick decision at a time.

How it works
- Swipe right to keep
- Swipe left to set it aside in the Archive
- Swipe up to move it into a locked album
- Clear the Archive in one go. Android asks once.

Why Onceover
- No ads. Nothing pops up while you swipe.
- Pay once. No weekly plan, no auto-renewal.
- Changed your mind? Photos go to your phone's trash first, recoverable for 30 days.
- Every swipe is saved. Leave and come back right where you stopped.
- Compare similar shots side by side and keep the best one.
- Your photos never leave your phone. No account, no uploads.

Sort your first 1,000 photos with every feature. Unlock the full version once to finish the rest.

The 30-day phone trash needs Android 11 or later. On Android 10 and earlier, Onceover warns you before deleting permanently.
